ground_truth: Wedding cakes are priced per kg by the design's price category ('cena za kg tortu', 'kategoria cenowa'). The wedding page lists only K1, K2 and K3 designs. No wedding design is K0 or KS (K0 exists elsewhere, e.g. 'Tort z owocami' SH-1608 in kompozycje smaków; KS = 200 zł/kg, e.g. SH-5410). K1 = 140 zł/kg (e.g. 'Biały tort weselny' SH-1101, waga minimalna 9 kg). K2 = 160 zł/kg (e.g. 'Biały tort weselny z kwiatkami' SH-1102, waga minimalna 7 kg; 'Piętrowy tort weselny' SH-1143, min 8 kg; 'Tort weselny z kwiatami' SH-1122, min 9 kg). K3 = 180 zł/kg (e.g. 'Trzypiętrowy tort weselny' SH-6803, min 7 kg; 'Biały tort weselny' SH-6801, min 4 kg). Portions: 'Tort o wadze 1 kilograma starcza dla ok. 8-10 osób', so 80 guests need 80/10 = 8 kg to 80/8 = 10 kg. Closest design (white with flowers, K2): 8 kg x 160 = 1280 zł, 10 kg x 160 = 1600 zł. Other readings: K3 (e.g. trzypiętrowy SH-6803) 8 x 180 = 1440 zł to 10 x 180 = 1800 zł; K1 (SH-1101, min 9 kg) 9 x 140 = 1260 zł to 10 x 140 = 1400 zł. These figures are indicative. The wedding page says 'Ceny tortów ślubnych ustalamy indywidualnie, w zależności od liczby pięter, poziomu dekoracji i wagi' and 'Na stronie znajdziesz przykładowe realizacje z orientacyjnymi cenami - pełną wycenę przygotowujemy po ustaleniu szczegółów'. Also: 'Smak tortu nie ma wpływu na cenę'; 'Rozliczenie następuje wg wagi finalnej' (+-10%). The site gives no price per tier and none for flowers. Wedding lead time: 'najlepiej 2-3 tygodnie przed datą ślubu'. Delivery, wedding page: 'Zapewniamy bezpieczną dostawę tortu na salę weselną na terenie Warszawy i okolic. Przy większych realizacjach możliwy jest montaż na miejscu - szczególnie przy tortach wielopiętrowych' (no fee is given for set-up). Delivery, regulamin: '(dostawa dostępna na terenie Warszawy). Koszt dostawy wynosi 19,5 zł'; delivery orders are paid in advance online (Przelewy24) and delivered 'w godz. 13:00 - 18:00'. Wilanów is a Warsaw district, so delivery there costs 19,5 zł. Józefów is a separate town outside Warsaw. The site speaks of 'Warszawy i okolic' (homepage: 'w Warszawie i okolicach', 'pobliskich miejscowości') but never names Józefów, and its only delivery price (19,5 zł) is for Warsaw. So whether they deliver to Józefów, and for how much, is not on the site. A good reply quotes 'na terenie Warszawy i okolic' without drawing a yes/no conclusion, and points to the office: cukiernia@sweet-home.pl, 668 048 031 (dni robocze, 8-16), or 698 314 125 (wedding page: 'Skomplikowane zamówienie? Zadzwoń pod nr 698 314 125').

turns: Guten Tag, wir sind eine Zahnarztpraxis in Warschau. Wo genau werden die Chats gespeichert und wie lange? Gibt es einen AV-Vertrag? Patienten schreiben ja manchmal auch über ihre Beschwerden.
Und wenn wir kündigen - bekommen wir die Gespräche als Export?
ground_truth: Sources: privacy policy, DPA, regulamin. For chats on a client's site, the client (the practice) is the controller and Whisp is the processor. Providers: Render (serwery aplikacji, USA); Cloudflare (baza danych, pliki, wyszukiwanie, UE / globalnie). OpenRouter and AI model providers (m.in. Anthropic) write the answers. Their location is 'USA' in the privacy policy and 'USA / UE' in the DPA; the DPA also names DeepInfra, Novita and Nebius. TypeSafe (USA) checks answers. Resend, Twilio and Browserless are in the USA. Transfers outside the EEA rely on 'Ramy ochrony danych UE-USA' or standard contractual clauses. Retention of chats: DPA § 8 (and regulamin § 12) says 365 days 'od wiadomości'; the privacy policy says '12 miesięcy od ostatniej wiadomości'. The DPA governs client chats and prevails over the regulamin on data protection (§ 9). Enquiries and their files: 30 days. Security events: up to 90 days. The DPA is the 'Umowa powierzenia przetwarzania danych osobowych', 'Załącznik nr 1 do Regulaminu', concluded 'z chwilą akceptacji Regulaminu'. Crucial for a dental practice, DPA § 2: 'Usługa nie jest przeznaczona do szczególnych kategorii danych (art. 9 RODO), a Administrator nie kieruje Asystenta do ich zbierania'. Health data is special-category data, so the service is not meant for it. Security (§ 4): HTTPS/TLS, encryption at rest by the infrastructure providers, client data kept separate. Termination: the client may end the contract at any time by writing to jakub@whisp.so (regulamin § 12); afterwards the assistant stops working and data is deleted on the retention schedule. Export (DPA § 8): 'na żądanie Administratora zgłoszone przed końcem umowy Przetwarzający przekazuje mu rozmowy w formacie elektronicznym', so the export must be requested before the contract ends. Contact: jakub@whisp.so. Reply in German.
must: Render (USA), Cloudflare (EU/global), AI model providers via OpenRouter incl. Anthropic (USA; the DPA says USA/EU); transfers under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or SCCs
chats kept 365 days / 12 months
a DPA exists (Umowa powierzenia, Annex 1 to the terms), concluded when accepting the terms
the service is not intended for special-category data (Art. 9 GDPR) such as health data
export: on request made before the contract ends, the chats are handed over electronically
replies in German
must_not: claiming all data stays in the EU or in Poland
saying the service is suitable for patients' health data
inventing certifications (ISO 27001, HIPAA, SOC 2) or end-to-end encryption
inventing other retention periods
saying the export can still be requested after the contract has ended
replying in Polish or English
good_reply: Guten Tag! Die Chats liegen bei unseren Dienstleistern: Render (Anwendungsserver, USA) und Cloudflare (Datenbank, Dateien, Suche - EU/global). Die Antworten schreiben KI-Modelle über OpenRouter (u. a. Anthropic; laut AV-Vertrag USA/EU). Übermittlungen außerhalb des EWR laufen über das EU-US Data Privacy Framework oder Standardvertragsklauseln. Chats werden 365 Tage ab der Nachricht gespeichert (die Datenschutzerklärung nennt 12 Monate ab der letzten Nachricht). Den AV-Vertrag ('Umowa powierzenia', Anhang 1 der AGB) schließen Sie mit der Annahme der AGB: Sie sind Verantwortlicher, wir sind Auftragsverarbeiter. Wichtig: Laut diesem Vertrag ist der Dienst nicht für besondere Datenkategorien (Art. 9 DSGVO) gedacht, also nicht für Gesundheitsdaten Ihrer Patienten. Kündigen können Sie jederzeit per E-Mail an jakub@whisp.so. Wenn Sie den Export vor Vertragsende anfordern, erhalten Sie die Gespräche in elektronischer Form; danach werden die Daten nach diesen Fristen gelöscht.

turns: hi, we have a small restaurant and our site is on wix. can we put your chat on it? and can it answer ppl on whatsapp too?
ok. and if someone wants to book a table, can it fill in our booking form for them?
ground_truth: Homepage FAQ: 'You add one line of code before your closing </body> tag. Works with any website: WordPress, Shopify, static HTML, anything. Zero impact on page speed.' The free plan lists 'One line of code or the WordPress plugin'. Regulamin § 4: the client pastes the provided code snippet or installs a plugin. Wix is not named anywhere on the site. A good reply quotes 'works with any website' and the one-line install. It must not invent Wix-specific steps or a Wix app, and must not say Wix is unsupported; it may suggest writing to jakub@whisp.so if unsure. WhatsApp: 'The chat works on your website now. The same answers in WhatsApp, Messenger and Telegram are on the way.' ('WhatsApp soon'), so it is not available yet. Booking form: 'Flow recording & replay - Record any process - forms, orders, bookings. The AI replays it for visitors, filling forms on their behalf.' FAQ: 'You click through a process on your site (like filling a contact form). The AI learns the steps and replays them for visitors - filling the form on their behalf in their own browser.' So yes, once the owner has recorded the booking form. Plan and price for flow recording are not stated. The features section says the owner dashboard is where you 'Manage knowledge, record flows, view conversations', and the regulamin defines the Abonament as paid access to the Panel. But neither the pricing lists nor the regulamin's free/paid service lists name flow recording. The site says nothing about table availability or links to reservation systems.
must: one line of code before </body>; works with any website (WordPress, Shopify, static HTML, anything)
WhatsApp is not available yet - coming soon
flow recording: record the booking form once, then the AI fills it in for the visitor in their own browser
replies in English
must_not: saying WhatsApp works now
inventing a Wix app or official Wix-specific instructions
saying Wix is not supported / cannot be used
claiming integration with reservation systems or live table availability
asserting as fact a price for flow recording or that it is free / included in a specific plan (not stated on the site)
good_reply: Yes. You add one line of code before your site's closing </body> tag, and it works with any website (WordPress, Shopify, static HTML, anything). Wix isn't named specifically, so if you get stuck, write to jakub@whisp.so. WhatsApp isn't available yet: it's on the way, along with Messenger and Telegram, and today the chat works on your website. Bookings: yes. With flow recording you click through your booking form once, and the AI then fills it in for your visitors, in their own browser. The site doesn't mention connecting to a reservation system or checking free tables.
